source.title: HST OPAL Cycle 31 Jupiter 2024c F395N/F467M/F658N global map
source.credit: NASA / ESA / HST OPAL Team (PI Amy Simon) / STScI; adapted by Starward

processing: Starward took the RGB median across valid longitudes in each latitude row of the historical three-filter map, omitted rows with under 90% coverage, and resized the resulting latitude profile to 8x512 RGBA PNG. This is an adaptation under CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Historical band colors from an arbitrarily scaled three-filter composite, not natural color or live Jovian weather.
Longitude-dependent features, including the 2024 Great Red Spot, were removed; no current feature longitude is claimed.
Transparent polar rows lack source coverage and must fall back to the plain computed globe.
